banner.provenance: The UA promotion arc round six, the sixth rules promotion batch from the Unearthed Arcana pin rounds: sixteen records promoted into content/rules/ua/ - rounds R391 through R423 complete (the pole arm nomenclature, the players tables, the treasure row bodies, the Appendix S block - the stat blocks, the clerical charts, the armor class table, the stat lines, the class lines, the move values, the pantheon prose - and the six cantrip families), one record per round per the OA header-record doctrine (the pin header stays the adjudicated record; the multi-header round merges the header pools), 366 model items (consts, bools, switches, chains), every record parsed back and compared equal (the lossless proof), the audit conditions converted to bad-detector examples. This batch is 242648 bytes of Lua. Cumulative seventy-one of the 76-round UA set, 5 rounds remaining.
